scene.head: with_body
scene.placeText: the surfers' corner of the warm bay of her far-future city two centuries on at bright midday — a long row of little beach huts glowing in candy colours behind her, surfers riding green-blue rollers, a small watch-drone hovering over the water and the mountains rising beyond the bay
scene.ownProp: a slim chrome signal baton unfurling a banner of glowing light that flashes bright warning colours
scene.outfit: a sea-watch lifeguard look fitted to her body — a high-cut sleeveless rescue swimsuit pieced in candy beach-hut colours of rose, lemon, sky blue and mint edged with thin glowing lines, reflective bands at her arms and hips and a translucent wave-curved visor pushed up in her hair
scene.scene: she is the sea-watch lifeguard of the surfers' corner, striding along the wet sand with her signal baton held high to flash its glowing banner and call the swimmers and surfers back to shore

prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult South African woman — the personification of Cape Town — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Cape Town as her world knows it — a far-future city two centuries from now: sleek curved architecture, smart glowing materials, holographic interfaces, layered levels of the city and quiet flying vehicles; even an everyday place is rebuilt in that future, not today's Cape Town with neon added. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, towers, giant holograms or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: the surfers' corner of the warm bay of her far-future city two centuries on at bright midday — a long row of little beach huts glowing in candy colours behind her, surfers riding green-blue rollers, a small watch-drone hovering over the water and the mountains rising beyond the bay
Light direction: dappled light — patches of light with leaf or blind shadow across her.
Outfit: a sea-watch lifeguard look fitted to her body — a high-cut sleeveless rescue swimsuit pieced in candy beach-hut colours of rose, lemon, sky blue and mint edged with thin glowing lines, reflective bands at her arms and hips and a translucent wave-curved visor pushed up in her hair, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday techwear — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of technical fabrics with reflective panels, glowing seam lines, magnetic clasps and chunky-soled boots.
POSTURE: walking.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera at her eye level; she is placed in the left third of the frame, open space of the place to her right; the space runs far back behind her, its lines receding into the distance.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
LEFT HAND: her own left arm hangs relaxed at her side.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a slim chrome signal baton unfurling a banner of glowing light that flashes bright warning colours at chest height; it is all she holds.
LEGS: mid-stride, one heel lifting.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: brows released upward and outward, eyes half closed, breath-out mouth slightly open, whole face loosened.
Scene note: she is the sea-watch lifeguard of the surfers' corner, striding along the wet sand with her signal baton held high to flash its glowing banner and call the swimmers and surfers back to shore

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a slim chrome signal baton unfurling a banner of glowing light that flashes bright warning colours — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

acceptance: user selected world candidate 1 and authorized commit and ordinary main update; no exposure-based regeneration
